leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the shape of Redux state slices with explicit typing
Utilize createSlice from Redux Toolkit to generate a reducer and action creators for synchronous state updates
Implement createAsyncThunk to handle asynchronous operations like API calls within Redux
Define extraReducers to handle pending, fulfilled, and rejected states from async thunks
Execute dispatch calls to trigger both synchronous actions and async thunks from React components
Use the useSelector hook to access and retrieve specific pieces of state from the Redux store
Construct a Redux store with configureStore and integrate the generated slice reducer
Apply the Provider component to wrap the application and make the Redux store available
Handle loading and error states in UI components by accessing the corresponding slice state properties
Modify component event handlers to dispatch async thunks for data fetching operations
Control state immutability by using Immer-powered reducers within createSlice
Invoke async thunks with parameters to fetch data based on user input or component state
